description: Bootable Windows recovery environment for offline system repair, troubleshooting, and data recovery.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $installer -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('O&O BlueCon setup was not found: ' + $installer) }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "O&O BlueCon installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)." }
if ($entries.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'O&O BlueCon is not registered as installed.'; return }
if ($entries.Count -gt 1) { throw 'Multiple O&O BlueCon uninstall entries were found; refusing to remove an ambiguous installation.' }

if ($productCode -notmatch '^\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}$') { $match = [regex]::Match([string]$entries[0].UninstallString, '\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}'); if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Could not determine the O&O BlueCon MSI ProductCode.' }; $productCode = $match.Value }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010, 1605)) { throw "O&O BlueCon uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (-not $version) { throw 'Unable to detect the O&O BlueCon version on the official O&O product releases page.' }

notes: Nonportable: runs O&O's official machine-wide installer. Administrator approval is required; a restart may be requested.
